name: Tsubaki Hirofumi
source:
Hirofumi is a senior employee at the convenience store where [url=http://vndb.org/c1633]Kouhei[/url] works, and has a friendly relationship with Kouhei. Hirofumi is gay and always goes out of his way to act gay around Kouhei. He is always trying to get Kouhei to play erotic games.

[From [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/P014]J-List[/url] and [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yume_Miru_Kusuri:_A_Drug_That_Makes_You_Dream]Wikipedia[/url]]
